verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page claims one-click reporting on team performance with data export, and says catalog/metadata enable more granular incident reporting. That is a first-party reporting capability for this story, but only marketing-level and with no specifics. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR metrics and trend views, incident-load analytics, on-call health/burden metrics, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving

citations.quote: Robust one-click reporting on your team's performance with a flexible data export.
Attach business knowledge to all incidents for more granular reporting and escalation rules with catalog and metadata.
